message: 舞い降りた天の使い

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, come on! My save data got wiped again!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you not to play battery-backup games since the battery's dead」

name: Paqy
message: 「Agh, back to kindergarten again... I can't deal with this~」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's play this game together instead. Look, a fun RPG」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell I can remember all those passwords one by one!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got a proper password notebook, so we'll be fine」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch... Fine, whatever」
Despite the complaining, we play co-op.

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy! Share the items properly!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ataaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, someone's here」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave 'em, Demon Lord!! Let's just take down the boss in one go!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Time out, time out」

name: Synn
message: 「Comiiing」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Amyrina」

name: Amyrina
message: 「G-Good evening...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Hm? Hmmm?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Umm!! W-Well!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「E... Err. Well, it is truly... unfortunate, but Lolotte is... um, not here!!」

name: Synn
message: 「So that means you're here alone, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes...」
Huh, that sound is...
Did Riesling-san drop her off all the way here?

name: Synn
message: 「I see, I see. What's up?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I am terribly sorry to bother you, but... might I have a moment of your time?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it... gonna take a while?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then come on in, come on in. It's cold out, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, it's just Angel Unit 02」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm gonna go make some tea, so take over for me, Amyrina」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eh, eh!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, what're we gonna do if we lose!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then we'll just try again」
Still, I'm surprised Amyrina came here all by herself...
I wonder what Lolotte is doing right now after being left behind.
Maybe she's off exploring somewhere?
No, she's probably worn out from playing and fast asleep.
Lately, she's been running around all over the place with me, after all.
Plus, the Holy Night Festival is coming up.
Spending the Holy Night Festival with Lolotte, huh~~.
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
Wait...
How rude of me... Amyrina came all this way, and here I am thinking only about Lolotte.
Still, Amyrina... What could be the matter for her to come all the way over at this hour?
Being timid and nervous is nothing new for her, yet today I can sense a different kind of determination.

name: Amyrina
message: 「L-Like this, perhaps?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh, nice! Alright, leave the kicking to me」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Then I shall go with punches」

name: Paqy
message: 「Counting on ya!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you manage to beat the boss?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, total piece of cake. This Angel Unit 02 actually knows how to divide up roles」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh-ho~~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Makes all the trouble I had up till now look stupid. So yeah, I can't team up with Lord Synn anymore」

name: Synn
message: 「What?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I've decided I'm only ever playing versus games with Master Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh, pretty uncooperative for a familiar...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Um... Mr. Panda. Would it be alright if we wrapped things up soon?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah! Make sure you jot down the password good, alright?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Password?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's kinda like a 'secret promise word' you need for the next time we play」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Next... time... you say...」

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong, angel?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「...Yes, that's right」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I... am actually an angel!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「What is with that reaction!! I'm an angel, you know!? Aren't you going to be even a little surprised, or scared... or anything!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Surprised?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Scared?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, no way, no way!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Talk about stating the obvious.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Does that mean, about Lolotte as well...」

name: Synn
message: 「She really is an angel... isn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「The vibe kind of made it feel like I shouldn't pry, so I didn't, but she really was an angel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, even knowing that, I doubt anything's gonna change from how things have been.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「...I see.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「No. I'm relieved that the person I'm speaking with is you, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gotcha... Here, have some tea.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes... Thank you for the tea.」
After taking a gentle sip, Amyrina looked straight at me with a serious expression.

name: Amyrina
message: 「However, this is the Human World. It is a realm where the world and the living beings within it shift and change alongside time.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Unlike our homeland of Heaven, things here properly change.」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of place is Heaven, anyway?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Heaven is a world where only beings of high spiritual nature can reside.」

name: Synn
message: 「Spiritual nature...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The power angels use is Spirit Arts... basically, the power of spirits. When the vast majority of what makes up a body is Spirit Power, that existence is called spiritual.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「In contrast, those who live in the Material World----the Human World and the Demon World--are referred to as material.」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means demons are also material, right?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes... Though on rare occasions, there are apparently demons who possess a spiritual nature as well.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Material beings cannot set foot in Heaven. However, spiritual beings are able to enter the Material World.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like Lolotte and you, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes. However...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「When a spiritual being descends into the Material World, their body gradually transforms into something material.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Basically, an angel turns into something like a human, yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「Then that means... Lolotte and you, Amyrina, will become human!?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Please calm down, President. Complete materialization requires a considerable number of years」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Therefore, transitioning into matter is not the primary issue」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then what else are you saying the problem is?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Angels are forbidden from going to the material world without permission」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte went without permission?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Always doing reckless things, that one...」

name: Synn
message: 「But why is it forbidden?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「We angels view turning into matter as a harmful effect」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Apparently, some angels cannot adapt to the environment of the material world and fall ill」

name: Synn
message: 「W-what did you say...?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Not only can they end up unable to return to our homeland, it can even become life-threatening!」

name: Synn
message: 「D-does that mean... Lolotte is in... danger?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I do not know... Only that there is a possibility...」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「The problem... is not limited to just that」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-there's still more\s01」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Are you aware that the shooting star anomaly--Re-Crea--is the cause?」

name: Synn
message: 「Re-Crea...!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...So that's what they call it in Heaven too」

name: Amyrina
message: 「We cannot observe the shooting stars from Heaven... However, an angel investigating in the Human World contacted us regarding this Re-Crea」

name: Amyrina
message: 「We do not even know what kind of impact the ripples of Re-Crea's power will have on the angels in the Human World」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That is why, before it is too late, we must return to Heaven, where the aftermath of Re-Crea should be minimal... as soon as possible...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「If we do not... Lolotte will... Lolotte will...」

name: Synn
message: 「Not just Lolotte! You're in the exact same boat, aren't you!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「But... Lolotte did not know this was going to happen. That is why, to tell her--」

name: Synn
message: 「...And I know you wouldn't just leave Lolotte behind and go back first, either」

name: Synn
message: 「It seems this Re-Crea is the biggest one yet. Helena said there's never been a time in history when this many shooting stars fell--」

name: Paqy
message: 「...!? Hold on a second」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Never once in the past... No, just once...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Back when I wasn't... a plushie yet, just once...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's right! I remember now! This is just like the very first time Re-Crea happened!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Really!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Unbelievable, you mean it's on the exact same scale as back then...」

name: Synn
message: 「Just how bad was it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Words can't even begin to describe it, though one thing's for sure--it had an extraordinary impact」

name: Paqy
message: 「Damn it! If only I weren't stuck looking like this...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mr. Panda... just who... are you...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, never mind Paqy for now. Anyway, it's dangerous for angels to stay in the Human World. That's the gist of it, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「So, Amyrina... what is it you want me to do?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「W-Well, that is...」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't come here just to talk about that... did you?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Um... well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry!\s01 I didn't mean to put you on the spot, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Get a grip, Amyrina. That's what you came here for, ain't it」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mr. Panda...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「...Understood!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mr. President」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Please persuade Lolotte to return to Heaven!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Persuade her, huh...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I'm sure if it's you, Mr. President... Lolotte will listen to what you have to say...」

name: Synn
message: 「So that means you already tried, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes! B-But...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Even if I try to persuade her, it's no use coming from me... I end up getting drawn in by Lolotte's smile」

name: Amyrina
message: 「...Even when I tell Lolotte we should return to Heaven...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte doesn't refuse, and instead tells me about all the fun and wonderful things in the Human World」

name: Amyrina
message: 「To imply to me that there's no need to flee... from such a lovely world...」

name: Synn
message: 「If Re-Crea passes, can you come to the Human World again?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「W-Well, that is...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「As I mentioned earlier... coming to the Human World is considered a taboo among angels...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「So... there is no guarantee... that we would ever be able to come to the Human World again...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte must know that too... That's why she would never... ever think of returning to Heaven...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Still, if she doesn't return to Heaven!! Lolotte will... Lolotte will...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「What should I... do... What can be done... for Lolotte...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I'm... a coward... In the end, on my own... I can't do anything...」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no one out there who can do everything all by themselves」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, together」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go persuade Lolotte!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, at this hour...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Comiiing!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh, Lolotte!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I heard Amyrina was intruding on you here--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, Amyrina!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eek!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Going out all alone in the middle of the night like this... Do you have any idea how worried I was~~!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「S-sorry, Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Honestly... Sneaking off to get a head start while I was asleep--that's so unfair!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, so that's what it was after all」

name: Riesling
message: 「Well then, everyone. Please take your time and enjoy yourselves」

name: Amyrina
message: 「G-Gramps!?」
W-what a smooth operator.
I wonder what Riesling himself is thinking, though.
Still, the fact that he created an opportunity for us like this means
Riesling must be worried about Lolotte's well-being too...
Well, of course he is.
It's not like she's going to die or anything, after all.
She's just going to be gone, that's all.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. Why don't we go for a little walk?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Okay~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's pouring down today too~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not rain, so I'm not sure about using that expression」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wonder why these shooting stars increase whenever Re-Crea draws near」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it's something like... an omen of a great catastrophe?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Give me a proper theoretical and logical answer, please」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's what you want, I don't think Re-Crea itself... can be explained theoretically」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've been thinking lately, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't you think there might be an important meaning behind this Re-Crea too?」

name: Synn
message: 「The meaning of Re-Crea...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though I have no idea at all... what that answer might be\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「The meaning of Re-Crea, huh.... I've never even thought about it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was taught that Re-Crea is transient. Once it passes, everything will be fine...」
I've never heard anything like that.
Does that mean that's how it's been passed down among the angels....

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, that isn't necessarily true. Because what we can see with our own eyes isn't everything」

name: Synn
message: 「We just simply accepted that Re-Crea is the way it is. Without even caring about what it means...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But now... aren't you starting to get curious? About the secret of Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. Though that's only because you brought it up, Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I feel like... for the first time, I was able to be of help to you, President♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is the exact same thing you've been doing for me all this time, President」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
I've spent all this time with Lolotte.
Every day getting caught up in Lolotte's antics was so much fun.
And in the same way, Lolotte also enjoyed being with me.
And so, she grew more and more.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... you've somehow become so admirable」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe... do you really think so?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All of this is because you've taught me so many things, President」
Those words, spoken so naturally... resonate deep in my chest.

name: Lolotte
message: 「From now on, instead of just being taught by you, President, I want to be able to teach you things too」
I can't bring myself... to talk openly about the future.

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, listen. Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I heard... from Amyrina. About, well--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「About returning to Heaven, you mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「You already... knew...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So the two of you were talking... about that today?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even I can tell right away if I just keep an eye on Amyrina」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina... isn't the Human World fun?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-No, that's not it!! I-It's not like that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then everything's fine, isn't it! We can just stay together like this forever--」

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina only brought it up because she's worried about your well-being, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...You mean about materialization?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina. If you've told him that much, then you've already...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I knew from the very beginning that it might negatively affect my body. I came here fully prepared for that much」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, fortunately... I haven't shown any abnormalities. Nothing on my body is impaired, and I haven't fallen ill once」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You spend the most time with me, President, so you should know that best of all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So there is nothing to worry about」

name: Synn
message: 「But... but if you stay here forever, you won't ever be able to go back... to Heaven...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm prepared for that as well」

name: Synn
message: 「But... this upcoming Re-Crea... isn't going to be... anything like a simple typhoon...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's on par with the biggest ones in history... I truly have no idea... how it might affect your body, Lolotte...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Back before the great me became a Plushie, there was a Re-Crea of the same scale-and let me tell you, it was brutal」

name: Paqy
message: 「A cataclysm that practically spelled the end of the world, plunging everything into chaos and disorder in its wake」

name: Paqy
message: 「And what happened to the angels during all that... I don't even want to remember--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda」

name: Paqy
message: 「N-ah?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not just the angels--what happened to everyone else?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Suppose we withdraw from the Human World and only we are saved」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What would become of everyone left behind in the Human World?」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Synn
message: 「To be honest... I don't know. Still, we'll... we'll figure something out on our own. So, Lolotte, you--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm one too!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm a member of the Crusaders as well, you know!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I know that! But... but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why won't you understand, President!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No matter what reason you give, I do not want to return to Heaven!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Going back to Heaven might guarantee my safety. Even so, far more important to me than that--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to stay together with you, President!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I go back to Heaven, I won't be able to stay with you anymore, President!! So...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So... no matter what excuse I have to make... I... want to... st--... stay in the Human World...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte... please... come back to Heaven with me...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「An angel who has lost their spiritual essence is... terribly powerless... Under the effects of Re-Crea, you'll lose everything」

name: Amyrina
message: 「In that case, let's at least... leave open the possibility that you can come to the Human World again someday!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「If you do that, the day will come when you can see the President again--」

name: Synn
message: 「Possibility, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「In the face of a phenomenon that can't be explained theoretically or logically. A word like 'possibility'... is completely useless」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, clinging to it... I think anyone's free to do that」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry... Amyrina」

name: Synn
message: 「I... feel the exact same way as Lolotte, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「And truthfully, I don't want to be apart from her for even a single moment anymore... Ah... Why didn't I just say it from the very beginning」

name: Synn
message: 「That if anything ever happens to Lolotte--」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll just have to protect her myself!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President...」

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina... I'll protect... your precious friend. There's no guarantee I'll be able to... Even so--」

name: Synn
message: 「If there's a possibility that everyone can be happy, I want to bet on it」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A possibility like that...」

name: Synn
message: 「As it turns out... there actually is one. A special trump card, you see」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... are you sure your body is really going to be okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. Can you see these wings?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「About a year has passed since I came to the Human World, yet I have still been able to maintain my spiritual form」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The proof of that is these angel wings--I kept it a secret until now, but actually, I... am an angel」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I knew」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You heard it from Amyrina, didn't you...」
Well, I actually knew even before that.

name: Synn
message: 「So, you see. I don't know if you'll believe me, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm actually the Demon Lord」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Demon Lord... Demon Lord... You mean the king of the demons?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right. I'm not human. I'm a demon. And the Demon Lord on top of that」

name: Amyrina
message: 「D-Demon L--!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Mgyu!!」
She fainted after all.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-Yes. I felt a little dizzy for a moment, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for keeping it a secret all this time」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is quite alright. We both... have our own circumstances, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... At first, I was scared of what you'd think of me. I couldn't bring myself to say it」

name: Synn
message: 「But right now, this Demon Lord power... feels reassuring. If it means I can protect you, Lolotte」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I might actually be able to do something about Re-Crea. And if I can, I figured it'd be okay to finally come clean!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President...」

name: Synn
message: 「A Demon Lord and an angel meeting like this. Maybe it's just a coincidence」

name: Synn
message: 「But just like the existence of Re-Crea itself, I'm sure there has to be a meaning behind it」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to believe in that possibility. Lolotte... will you trust me, even though I'm the Demon Lord...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whether you are the Demon Lord or not... Mr. President is still Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Thank you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「By the way, should I address you as Mr. Demon Lord... from now on?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no. Normal is fine\s02」
